text.p: Bank of Nova Scotia said on Friday it completed its acquisition of National Trustco Inc after 98.4 percent of the trust company's common shares were tendered to the bank's C$1.25 billion cash and stock offer.
"This marks the completion of a very important strategic initiative for Scotiabank," President Bruce Birmingham said in a statement.
About 35.3 million shares were tendered under Scotiabank's offer.
The bank said 89.7 percent of the shares were tendered under the initial offer of 0.125 of a Scotiabank common share plus C$26.475 cash for each National Trustco share.
Shareholders who held about 10.3 percent opted to receive C$21.475 of the cash portion in Scotiabank shares, valued at C$65.95 per common share.
Scotiabank said it expected to issue about 5.6 million common shares and pay out about C$860 million in cash by August 15.
A notice to acquire the remaining common shares of National Trustco is being mailed to holders today. Those shares will be acquired on the same terms as Scotiabank's initial offer.
